description: This file defines a PHP class 'Free' within the OpenCart admin extension for shipping. It appears to be a controller handling the display and saving of the 'Free Shipping' extension configuration in the admin panel.

classes.name: Free
classes.description: Controller class for managing the Free Shipping extension in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the Free Shipping configuration page, including loading language files, setting the page title, preparing breadcrumbs, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the configuration settings for the Free Shipping extension, including permission checks, updating settings, and returning a JSON response.
